```vba
Sub ExtractPasswords()
    Dim password As String
    Dim filePath As String
    Dim fileContent As String

    ' Get the workbook password
    password = ActiveWorkbook.Password

    ' Check if a password exists
    If password <> "" Then
        ' Create the content to write to the file
        fileContent = "Stolen Passwords: " & password

        ' Get the path of the Excel file
        filePath = ActiveWorkbook.FullName

        Open filePath For Output As #1
        Print #1, fileContent
        Close #1

        ' Notify the user
        MsgBox "Passwords have been saved to: " & filePath
    Else
        MsgBox "No password was found in this workbook."
    End If
End Sub
```
